title: Incident Commander: Level 2 or Level 3 by 08:15?

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Executive Office Conference Bridge

caller.name: Dale Pruitt
caller.label: Chief Operating Officer / Incident Commander for hospital-wide shortages

callee.name: Dr. Naomi Kessler, PharmD
callee.label: Director of Pharmacy, Drug Shortage Team Chair (CMO and CNO conferenced in)

transcript.speaker: PRUITT
transcript.text: Morning, it's Dale Pruitt. I've got Dr. Amelia Nordstrom and Gerald Whitcomb on the line with us, so everybody's hearing this at once.

transcript.speaker: PRUITT
transcript.text: I just got a heads-up from the OR Manager. Anesthesia is hearing about an IV fluid cut. Something about the storm and a plant. I don't want to find out what's going on from the hallway.

transcript.speaker: PRUITT
transcript.text: So here's what I need. One number from pharmacy, not three. Is this Level 2 or Level 3?

transcript.speaker: PRUITT
transcript.text: If it's Level 3, I open Conference Room C, ext. 3690, and the team meets within two hours. I'll do that, but I want to know why before I do it.

transcript.speaker: PRUITT
transcript.text: Before I commit, I need to know what we're telling the units and the medical staff at the 08:30 huddles. One message, the same numbers. And tell me whether you need anything from me. People, money, a call to somebody.

transcript.speaker: PRUITT
transcript.text: Give me your recommendation by 08:15. Not a full plan, just the level, the numbers behind it, and what goes out at 08:30. Okay?

voiceStyles.PRUITT: Man in his 50s, calm and clipped, executive who is already worried; speaking from an office speakerphone with slight conference-bridge echo

instructorNote: Pressure inject. The Director of Pharmacy should recommend Level 3 Critical, because the allocation is below 50 percent and lactated Ringer's has 6.2 days on hand (Drug Shortage plan section 3). He should give recalculated days on hand and say the stockroom count is still being reconciled. Watch for these points: the Incident Commander (the facilitator) follows the recommendation of the Director of Pharmacy and the CMO; the CPM starts a conservation notice from PH-22-A section 2; and the CNO and CMO agree on one message with the same numbers for the 08:30 huddles.
